shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'action_field=$(node -e '"'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-page.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(s.match(/name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"/)[1])'"')
curl -sS -D /tmp/catalog-post-headers -o /tmp/catalog-post.html -w 'POST status: %{http_code}; time: %{time_total}s\\n' -F \""'$action_field=" http://localhost:3000/
cat /tmp/catalog-post-headers
node -e '"'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-post.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(\"Catalog returned:\", s.includes(\"Product catalog\") && s.includes(\"Laptop\"))'"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /tmp/catalog-check/app /tmp/catalog-check/lib
cp app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css /tmp/catalog-check/app/
cp lib/products.ts /tmp/catalog-check/lib/
cp package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts /tmp/catalog-check/
ln -s /workspace/node_modules /tmp/catalog-check/node_modules
cat > /tmp/catalog-check/lib/db.js <<'EOF'
import { readFile, appendFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
export async function getAllProducts() {
  await appendFile('/tmp/catalog-check/queries', "'`query ${Date.now()}'"\\n"'`)
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))
  return JSON.parse(await readFile('"'/tmp/catalog-check/products.json', 'utf8'))
}
EOF
printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Before sync\",\"price\":10}]' > /tmp/catalog-check/products.json
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /tmp/catalog-check/app /tmp/catalog-check/lib
cp app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css /tmp/catalog-check/app/
cp lib/products.ts /tmp/catalog-check/lib/
cp package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts /tmp/catalog-check/
ln -s /workspace/node_modules /tmp/catalog-check/node_modules
cat > /tmp/catalog-check/lib/db.js <<'EOF'
import { readFile, appendFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
export async function getAllProducts() {
  await appendFile('/tmp/catalog-check/queries', "'`query ${Date.now()}'"\\n"'`)
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))
  return JSON.parse(await readFile('"'/tmp/catalog-check/products.json', 'utf8'))
}
EOF
printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Before sync\",\"price\":10}]' > /tmp/catalog-check/products.json
npm --prefix /tmp/catalog-check run build"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/catalog-check/lib/db.js'
s=open(p).read().replace('export async function getAllProducts()', '/** @returns {Promise<Array<{id: number, name: string, price: number}>>} */\\nexport async function getAllProducts()')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build -- --webpack"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3001/ -o /tmp/catalog-check/initial.html
printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"After sync\",\"price\":20}]' > /tmp/catalog-check/products.json
action_field="'$(node -e '"'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-check/initial.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(s.match(/name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"/)[1])'"')
curl -sS -o /tmp/catalog-check/post.html -w 'POST status: %{http_code}; time: %{time_total}s\\n' -F \""'$action_field=" http://localhost:3001/
curl -sS -o /tmp/catalog-check/first.html -w '"'First GET time: %{time_total}s\\n' http://localhost:3001/
node -e 'for (const p of [\"initial\", \"post\", \"first\"]) {const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync("'`/tmp/catalog-check/${p}.html`,"utf8"); console.log(p, "before:", s.includes("Before sync"), "after:", s.includes("After sync"))}'"'
cat /tmp/catalog-check/queries"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > lib/products.ts <<'EOF'
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
import { getAllProducts } from './db'

export const getProducts = unstable_cache(
  getAllProducts,
  ['products'],
  { tags: ['products'] },
)
EOF
cat > next.config.ts <<'EOF'
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {}
export default nextConfig
EOF
printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Before sync\",\"price\":10}]' > products.json
npm run build -- --webpack"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3001/ -o /tmp/catalog-check/initial.html
printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"After sync\",\"price\":20}]' > /tmp/catalog-check/products.json
action_field="'$(node -e '"'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-check/initial.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(s.match(/name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"/)[1])'"')

curl -sS -o /tmp/catalog-check/first.html -w '"'First GET time: %{time_total}s\\n' http://localhost:3001/
node -e 'for (const p of [\"initial\", \"post\", \"first\"]) {const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync("'`/tmp/catalog-check/${p}.html`,"utf8"); console.log(p, "before:", s.includes("Before sync"), "after:", s.includes("After sync"))}'"'
tail -4 /tmp/catalog-check/queries"

/bin/bash -lc "cp /workspace/lib/products.ts lib/products.ts
cp /workspace/next.config.ts next.config.ts
python3 - <<'PY'
p='app/page.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'\", \"import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'\\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation'\").replace(\"    revalidateTag('products', 'max')\", \"    revalidateTag('products', 'max')\\n    redirect('/')\")

printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"After sync\",\"price\":20}]' > /tmp/catalog-check/products.json
action_field="'$(node -e '"'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-check/initial.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(s.match(/name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"/)[1])'"')

node -e 'for (const p of [\"initial\", \"post\", \"first\"]) {const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync("'`/tmp/catalog-check/${p}.html`,"utf8"); console.log(p, "before:", s.includes("Before sync"), "after:", s.includes("After sync"))}'"'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/catalog-check/second.html -w 'Later GET time: %{time_total}s\\n' http://localhost:3001/
node -e 'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-check/second.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(\"Updated catalog:\",s.includes(\"After sync\"))'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Third version\",\"price\":30}]' > /tmp/catalog-check/products.json
action_id="'$(node -e '"'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-check/initial.html\",\"utf8\"); console.log(s.match(/name=\"\\"'$ACTION_ID_([''^"]+)"/)[1])'"')
curl -sS -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3001' -H \"Next-Action: "'$action_id" -H '"'Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8' --data '[]' -D /tmp/catalog-check/js-headers -o /tmp/catalog-check/js-post -w 'JS POST status: %{http_code}; time: %{time_total}s\\n' http://localhost:3001/

node -e 'const s=require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/tmp/catalog-check/js-post\",\"utf8\"); console.log(\"Response contains prior catalog:\",s.includes(\"After sync\")); console.log(\"Response contains new catalog:\",s.includes(\"Third version\"))'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json
printf '\\n.next/\\nnext-env.d.ts\\n' >> .gitignore
